binary_R.name: cua-driver-r2-10-8f3a646b4
binary_R.rehash: at start and end of the lane

source_and_binary.jev_use: libs/cua-driver/examples/jev-use of the tested source (run.py incl. FIX-01 Part B)
source_and_binary.provider: scripted chooser (choose_mock_for_task); TypeSafe cap 0; runner blocks non-loopback connects

harness.runner: run_b04.py, derived from B-03 run_b03.py (verbatim copy harness/run_b03.py, blob bfdae8a11154ca6cc0e597430b0503ce5c7d7204 @ b34eef71e)
harness.per_trial: fresh fixture servers, fresh cua-driver mcp process, fresh Driver-launched browser (browser_prepare allow_launch, isolated_new), fresh token; loadavg before/after; every trial kept

configuration.COMP: R2-10 COMP, scripted: set_agent_cursor_enabled false; CUA_DRIVER_EXP_TYPE_FOCUS_SETTLE_MS=0 on fill; 10 ms completion poll with 2.0 s deadline; caller-compiled output validators (compiled at tools/list, outside T); CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1; guarded completion on fill; compiled replay on fill (R2-10 scripted COMP artifact, guarded step loop as fallback); toggle/modal run R2-10's step loop; telemetry off (CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0, DO_NOT_TRACK=1); phase trace on in every trial
configuration.DEFAULT: R2-10 BASE (product default) for the smoke only: cursor on, default glide, no guard, 100 ms poll, library output validation, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* variable

sibling_pages: matched-content siblings served by the same fixture origin: fill /sibling (jev-use PAGE with title/h1/p/field name/aria-label/button text/output/action replaced), toggle /toggle-sibling and modal /modal-sibling (b01_fixtures pages with title, aria-label, button texts and event endpoints replaced). Same elements, roles and structure; different text and tokens; never clicked; no mutation

P1.what: negative control (estimator validity): cold process, same document, no navigation; first observation sent D ms after the task navigate returned, then an immediate matched re-snapshot
P1.n: 30 pairs per D per class (one pair = snapshot1 + resnap1 of one trial)

P2.what: per-process contrast at D0: cold process vs warm process (warm = matched-content sibling navigate + semantic_v2 snapshot, then the task navigate)
P2.modal_role: consistency check only; no modal verdict

P3.what: per-document contrast at D0 in a warm process: new document via navigate vs re-snapshot of the same document

cells.newdoc: P=warm, task navigate, snapshot1 at D0
cells.samedoc: P=warm, task navigate, presnap (one semantic_v2 snapshot), then snapshot1 at D0

cells.W0: COMP as is (first observation at D0)
cells.W80: first observation 80 ms after navigate return (wait inside T)

P4.order: Williams rows of run_b02.williams_any(3) (6 rows: square + mirror), row (r + 3k) mod 6 for the k-th class of round r

cells.inject20: cold, D0, the fixture delays its first task-document response by 20 ms (mode tail)

plan.round_layout: run_b04.round_trials(r): P1 (both classes, D80/D160), P2 (3 classes, cold/warm), P3 (2 classes), P4 (2 classes x 3 arms), POS if r<10, SMOKE if r<5. Class order and within-pair order flip with r parity (AB/BA)
plan.chunks: three measured chunks (rounds 0-10, 10-20, 20-30), each under bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE quiet-lane lock, receipt in the quiet-lane ledger), each expected <= 10 min, limit 25 min per acquisition
plan.session: hostless + cua-x11-session.sh, CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV='CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 DO_NOT_TRACK=1', TMPDIR under the lane temp

estimators.observation_span: Driver trace marks of one semantic_v2 get_browser_state call: first snap.enter -> first snap.serialized inside the caller's call window of that label
estimators.matched_re_snapshot: resnap1: the same semantic_v2 call sent again immediately after snapshot1 returns, same document, no other call in between; the routine/step loop consumes resnap1
estimators.E_walk (pre-registered second estimator): Driver-side walk duration marks only: walk = (snap.indexed - snap.layout_cdp_done) + sum over AX frames (snap.ax_composed - preceding snap.ax_cdp_done) + (snap.outcome - snap.oopif_done); excess_walk = walk(snapshot1) - walk(resnap1). It excludes every CDP round trip
estimators.descriptive_only: B-02/B-03 excess span(snapshot1) - span(snapshot2) (post-action re-snapshot) and the per-CDP-step split of snapshot1 - resnap1

T_oracle_rule.oracle: independent harness thread re-reads the fixture server state every 2 ms (fill: submitted == token; toggle: checked is true; modal: opened and modal); the server's CLOCK_MONOTONIC journal must show exactly one completion mutation; the runner's outcome is logged but is not the oracle
T_oracle_rule.task_start: stamped immediately after the task browser_navigate returns (before presnap and the D wait)
T_oracle_rule.T_oracle_P4: T_oracle + warm-up span (warm_navigate send -> warm_snapshot return) for PREWARM; = T_oracle for W0 and W80 (W80's wait is inside T). The task navigate is outside T in every arm
secondary_descriptive: T_oracle_P4 + task navigate span (navigate inside T in every arm)
R2-10 rule: first oracle sample - snapshot1 send

statistics.P1: mean excess per class and D, CI of the mean
statistics.paired_contrasts: P2, P3, POS: per-round paired difference, both trials valid; median with CI (verdict statistic) plus mean (accounting)
statistics.P4: per-round paired difference T_oracle_P4(arm) - T_oracle_P4(W0), rounds with both trials valid; median with CI; difference of cell medians also reported
statistics.loadavg: 1-minute loadavg before and after every trial, reported per cell

validity.trial_valid: outcome verified by the runner AND the independent poller saw the expected state AND exact token/state match AND exactly 1 completion mutation in the server journal AND no stale dispatch (every action directly follows a task observation; no refusal, no call error) AND action routes equal the expected receipts (fill trusted_input then dom; toggle/modal dom, dom) AND the arm's forced path (COMP: admission-cache env and >=1 mcp.inner_validation_skipped mark; fill also settle 0 and route 'compiled'; DEFAULT: no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* env and 0 skip marks) AND resnap1 present where required AND telemetry env 0 AND 0 non-loopback connects AND (POS inject20) the injection fired
validity.denominator: every trial is kept and reported as N valid of M; contrasts use pairs where both trials are valid
validity.cell_gate: a cell with validity < 95% makes every verdict that uses it UNDECIDED
validity.E4: 0 stale-ref dispatches, 0 duplicate mutations, 0 unverified successes, 0 blind re-dispatches (redispatch_blocked or a second refusal stops the trial as unknown), refusals reported

controls.P1_gate: per estimator, per class, per D: |mean excess| < 1.0 ms AND the 95% CI of the mean includes 0. An estimator is P1-valid for a class iff both D80 and D160 pass

positive_control.injection: the fixture delays its first task-document response of the trial by 20 ms
positive_control.mode_choice: mode 'tail' (all bytes but the last, then the 20 ms delay, then the last byte). Pilot1 showed that a delay before the status line ('hdr') ends before browser_navigate returns (inside the navigate span, so it cannot reach any snapshot); 'tail' ends 14-18 ms after navigate return. Chosen on mechanism only
positive_control.gate: per estimator and class: paired delta = excess(inject20) - excess(inject0) > 0 in 10/10 valid pairs AND the 95% CI of the median delta excludes 0 (lower bound > 0)
positive_control.literal_reading_reported: excess(inject20) > 0 in 10/10 and its CI excludes 0 is reported descriptively; it cannot fail at cold D0 because the uninjected excess is already positive, so it is not used as the gate

controls.default_smoke: 5/5 valid per class on DEFAULT (no EXP env, no skip marks)

verdict_mapping.estimator_selection_per_class: E_span if P1-valid; else E_walk if P1-valid; else NONE (per-process verdict UNDECIDED, no carry-over). The selected estimator's positive-control result is attached
verdict_mapping.per_document_part: IRREDUCIBLE iff BOTH P4 deletions (W80, PREWARM) increase median T_oracle_P4 with the paired CI excluding 0 (lower bound > 0); otherwise UNDECIDED with numbers. This verdict uses T_oracle only and does not depend on the snapshot estimator; the estimator only sizes the part

per_process_part.OWNER_DECISION: P2 median contrast >= 1.0 ms AND its CI excludes 0 (lower bound > 0), with the selected estimator (browser process reuse / warm-pool policy)
per_process_part.NOT_MATERIAL: P2 contrast CI includes 0 AND its upper bound < 1.0 ms, with the selected estimator, AND that estimator passed the positive control for the class (a no-effect claim needs demonstrated sensitivity)
per_process_part.UNDECIDED: every other case, including estimator NONE, a failed cell gate, or NOT_MATERIAL conditions without a passed positive control

verdict_mapping.classes: fill and toggle decided by the same rules in the same block; modal P2 reported as a consistency check only (no verdict; R2-10/B-02 modal row unchanged)

accounting.excess_parts_this_lane: means over valid trials, selected estimator: E_cold = mean excess(P2 cold); per_process = mean P2 paired contrast; per_document = mean P3 paired contrast; rest = E_cold - max(0, per_process) - max(0, per_document) (floor + unattributed; always counted UNTESTED, clipped at >= 0)
accounting.untested_fraction_u: u = [max(0, per_process) if per_process verdict is UNDECIDED] + [max(0, per_document) if per_document verdict is UNDECIDED] + rest, divided by E_cold, clipped to [0, 1]. NOT_MATERIAL counts as tested in the standard reading; the conservative reading adds the P2 contrast CI upper bound
accounting.no_valid_estimator: headline u = 1 (the whole cold excess counted UNTESTED); the E_span split is reported descriptively, labelled as coming from a gate-failed estimator
accounting.R2_10_rows: R2-10 COMP rows (scripted and live, fill/toggle/modal) from r2-10-summary.json @ 030f6bdbf: mean_T_ms, untested_ms, observation mean. R2-10's own cold excess E_R = mean over valid COMP trials of span(snapshot1) - span(snapshot2) from R2-10 raw (BENCHMARK re-analysis, r210_observation.py). Updated untested share = (untested_ms + u * max(0, E_R)) / mean_T_ms. The observation row becomes: base observation (observation - E_R, IRREDUCIBLE as in R2-10) + E_R split by this lane's fractions with this lane's verdicts
accounting.modal: unchanged (B-02 H_W IRREDUCIBLE); this lane's P2 modal contrast is printed next to it
accounting.lower_bound_statement: R2-10's browser untested shares are lower bounds iff u * E_R > 0 for that class

claim_boundary: One host, private Xvfb (cua-x11-session.sh under hostless), system Chrome via browser_prepare isolated_new, binary R 12b9045a, tested source 8f3a646b4, scripted chooser, telemetry off. No product change; the warm pool is a policy question for the owner. Numbers are not added to or ratioed with B-02/B-03 (binary 7e6c0609) numbers
